column2: Jun 25 2026 (pkl backtest, n=3102): PM 1.022-1.082 + Park<0.90 + Vuln 30-55 + Edge≥1%. pkl: 33.3% HR (4.40x, n=18, p=0.0016). column1: 🎯 Elite command (CSW)
column2: Pitcher CSW% ≥33%. Called Strikes + Whiffs as % of total pitches. Target >30% per video. Better than SwStr% alone because it adds called strikes (K-looking). Elite command = fewer good count situations = fewer HR opportunities.

column2: Pitcher CSW% <25%. Losing the zone — batters working counts, getting into HR-friendly hitter's counts (2-0, 3-1). Combined with Z-Contact ≥88% is the strongest HR-prone discipline signal.

column1: ⚡ High Z-Contact
column2: Pitcher Z-Contact% ≥88%. Batters making easy in-zone contact. For HR scoring: model boosts xSLG contribution weight from 25× to 35× for these pitchers. column2: Pitcher O-Swing% ≥36%. Batters swinging at pitches outside the zone. Above the 32% average. Gets batters expanding zone = fewer walks = fewer base-runners = fewer HR opportunities.

column1: 👁️ Low chase rate
column2: Pitcher O-Swing% <28%. Batters staying disciplined — not chasing bad pitches. Working good counts, getting pitches to hit.

column1: 📊 ERA composite
column2: Average of FIP, xFIP, and SIERA when all three are available. When composite diverges ≥0.75 from ERA, the composite is more predictive. ERA understated = pitcher luckier than skills suggest. ERA overstated = pitcher tougher than ERA implies, regression candidate for HR picks. When ERA understated ≥0.75 + PM≥1.03 + Pwr≥55 + no short start, fires the formal 📊 ERA Understated HR supplemental grade (see above).

column1: SIERA
column2: Skill-Interactive ERA from FanGraphs. Incorporates K%, BB%, and GB% more accurately than FIP. SIERA > FIP usually means the pitcher has been getting HR luck (low HR/FB despite weak contact). Better for pitchers with extreme GB% or K%.

column1: 💥 XX edge 0.XXX
column2: Individual pitch-type edge flag (June 2026). Fires when a batter has wOBA ≥0.100 above league average vs a specific pitch type (SL/CU/CH/ST/SI/FC/FF) AND that pitch is the pitcher's meaningful weapon (≥12% usage). Format: '💥 SL edge 0.423 38%bb' = batter wOBA 0.423 vs slider, 38% barrel rate. Only fires for genuinely elite edges — mild +1/+2 conv edges are scored but not flagged. Pairs with 🎯 Pitch corr flag when pitcher is also weak on the same pitch.

column2: HIT-ONLY suppressor (Jun 15 2026): Pitcher Vuln < 38 = genuinely elite arm. The same quality that prevents HRs also suppresses hits. column2: Pitcher making their first start of the year, having only appeared in relief to this point. Detected when all 2026 game log appearances show gamesStarted=0. Scoring (June 2 audit — increased): +4.0 opp_score boost + +5.0 base conv pts; +2.5 more if batter OPS≥0.900 or HR rate≥5% career vs pitcher; +2.5 more if batter crushes this pitcher's primary pitch type (pitch_edge_bonus≥3.0). Max conv boost: +10.0 pts. Plus +12% ranking_score multiplier. Total max lift: very significant. Relief stats (ERA, K/9, HR/9) don't translate to starting — the pitcher hasn't paced over 100+ pitches, hasn't faced a lineup 3x through, may have diminished velocity/command. Short-start 'neutral/negative for HR' note suppressed; vulnerability is on the starter.

column1: 🎯 PitchMix wOBA
column2: Batter wOBA weighted by THIS pitcher's actual pitch distribution. The Barrel Boyz 'PitchMix AVG' signal (e.g. Schwarber .265 vs Vasquez mix). Computed as: sum(pitcher_usage_pct × batter_wOBA_vs_pitch_type). More precise than individual pitch type edges — accounts for HOW OFTEN the pitcher throws each pitch. ≥0.400 = elite (+4 conv), ≥0.370 = strong (+2). Requires ≥30% pitch coverage for reliable estimate.

column1: 📊 wRC+ vs hand
column2: Batter wRC+ specifically vs RHP or LHP (Barrel Boyz 'wRHP%/wLHP%' metric). Index where 100 = league average. 147 = 47% better than average vs that hand. Source: FanGraphs batting splits. ≥140 = elite (+2 conv), ≥120 = good (+1). ≤75 = struggles vs this hand (-1.5 conv). Different from wOBA — this is context-adjusted.

column1: 🍖 Meatball rate (pitcher)
column2: % of pitches the pitcher leaves in the heart of the zone (league avg ~8-9%). Source: Baseball Savant pitcher leaderboard. Directly measures 'HR-friendly contact' — Propfinder methodology uses this alongside barrel%, HH%, and HR/FB% to rank pitchers by HR risk. ≥12% = elite meatball rate, pitcher frequently over the plate. Contributes to pitcher_vuln_score and surfaces as 🍖 flag in picks tables.

column1: 🎯 Pitch correlation
column2: Two-sided pitch matchup check from Propfinder methodology: pitcher is weak on their primary pitch type (high wOBA/barrel% allowed on that pitch) AND batter specifically crushes that same pitch type. The 'direct correlation between pitcher weakness and hitter strength'. Fires as a note in detailed breakdown and flag in picks table. More precise than one-sided batter wOBA edge alone — both sides must confirm.

column1: 🎯 N BZM-SZN (PT): zones
column2: Barrel Zone Match (BZM) — a hyperlocal pitch-location edge. Fires when (1) the pitcher locates ≥12% of in-zone pitches of type PT in a specific strike zone cell (season data, normalized to in-zone pitches only), AND (2) the batter's season xwOBA in that same cell is ≥.400 (solidly above average). N = number of matching zones; PT = pitch type (FF, SI, SL, etc.); zones are labeled up/in, up, up/out, mid-in, middle, mid-out, low-in, low, low/out. Example: '🎯 2 BZM-SZN (FF): up/in, middle' = pitcher locates his four-seamer to the up/in and middle zones most often, and the batter has elite xwOBA in both cells. Higher N = more overlapping hot-spot edges on this exact pitch type. Both pitcher and batter use season data for stable zone coverage (200-400+ events). Conviction boost: +2 for 1 zone match, +4 for ≥2 zone matches (from Jun 15 2026). Only fires inside the pitch-correlation block — both sides of the matchup must already be confirmed before BZM is evaluated. Jun 15 2026 first live slate: 4/7 HR (57%), 5/7 hit (71%) across all BZM picks.

column1: 🎯 BZM COMBO HR
column2: TRACKING grade (Jun 15 2026): Multi-zone Barrel Zone Match with full-quality matchup confirmation — the most stringent BZM condition. Fires when ALL of: (1) BZM ≥ 2 zones matched; (2) Pitch quality signal confirmed (Pitch Corr OR PitchMix wOBA ≥.400 OR PITCH DOM EDGE); (3) Vuln 44-52 OR a dead-zone-override grade (CONFIRMED MATCH etc.); (4) At least one documented pitcher weakness (weak bullpen HR/9, ERA understated, HR-prone L5, Z-Contact ≥88%); (5) PitchMix wOBA ≥.400. Conviction: +5 (above single-BZM credits). Jun 15 live: 1/1 HR (100%, n=1 — Burleson, 2 BZM + CONFIRMED MATCH + pitch edge + bullpen 1.67). Historical backtest not possible (BZM is a new signal). Track going forward.

column1: 🏟️ POWER PARK HR
column2: TRACKING grade (Jun 15 2026, Contreras archetype): Fires when the hand-specific park factor is extreme (≥1.20x) AND the bat/matchup structure is solid (PM≥1.04 + Power≥79 + Vuln 44-52). Surfaces extreme park advantages that the main scoring engine under-weights. Contreras hit 2 HRs at +390 with RHB park 1.280x vs Eovaldi — model gave him Conv 17 (LEAN, no named grade) because the park factor wasn't weighted into any grade. Fires as a supplemental grade when no primary pitch-edge grade already catches the pick. Conviction: +4. Jun 15 live: 1/1 HR (100%, n=1). Validate over next 10+ slates.

column1: 🎯 Pitch edge
column2: Sub-signal and formal grade (🎯 PITCH EDGE HR). Fires when a batter earns a full pitch dominance edge bonus (≥+4 conv from crushing the pitcher's primary pitch type) but the PITCH DOMINANCE HR primary grade is blocked — most commonly by a short-start (pitcher projected <4.8 IP) or by the PM gate. The batter has near-PITCH DOM level contact quality against this pitcher's arsenal; the grade just couldn't fire cleanly. As a sub-signal it appears in the Grade column alongside the primary grade. As a formal grade (🎯 PITCH EDGE HR) it counts toward grade_count and stacking tiers when firing alongside SHARP PM HR or MID-SCORE HR. First validated: Yordan Alvarez HR vs Bubba Chandler, June 2 2026 (PITCH DOM blocked by 4.8 IP short-start; PITCH EDGE HR fired; Alvarez homered at +250).

column1: 🚨 Multi-factor HR risk
column2: Pitcher has 3+ of 6 independent HR risk signals elevated simultaneously: Barrel% allowed ≥10%, Hard Hit% ≥42%, HR/FB% ≥15%, Meatball% ≥10%, GB% ≤38% (fly-ball pitcher), K% ≤16% (can't miss bats). This is the Propfinder 'Pitcher HR Risk Score' concept — multiple metrics confirming the same underlying HR vulnerability. 2 factors = ⚠️ Dual HR risk.

column1: 🚨 Elite barrel rate allowed
column2: Pitcher barrel rate against ≥12% (≈1.6x league avg). Source: Baseball Savant pitcher leaderboard. Already used in pitcher_vuln_score(). Now surfaced as a user-visible flag. Key signal per analysts: Vasquez 13.2% = 5th percentile worst, Sugano 12.8%/PA = worst of 150 pitchers — means batters routinely square them up.

column1: ⚠️ High barrel% allowed
